title: screenshot structuredContent
description: Frame metadata. The image itself is the image content block of the same result.

screenshot_error.description: A tool_error with one of the codes that screenshot can return (docs/contract.md section 9.3).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the encoded image bytes, that is, of the image content block's data after base64 decoding.

capture_rect.description: The rectangle actually captured, in global points.

source_pixel_size.description: Size of capture_rect in native pixels.

output_pixel_size.description: Size of the returned image. Pointer targets are expressed in this pixel space. Neither edge is over 2576, and width times height is at most 3,588,000, which a schema cannot state.

point_pixel_scale.description: Native pixels per point for this display.

downscale.description: The scale applied to the source pixels, in (0, 1]. 1 means not downscaled.

jpeg_quality.description: The JPEG quality used. Present exactly when format is jpeg.

image_bytes.description: Size of the encoded image before base64. At most 3,750,000, so the base64 text is at most 5,000,000 characters.

max_age_ms.description: The frame is refused as too_old once this many milliseconds have passed since captured_at.

pointer_position.description: Where the pointer was at capture, in output pixels, or null when it was outside capture_rect. The pointer is never drawn into the image.

frontmost_app.description: The frontmost app at capture. When deskhand could not determine one: bundle_id and team_id null and name empty.
